effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] When this Digimon would digivolve into [Eosmon], reduce the digivolution cost by 1.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When another [Eosmon] is played, this Digimon may digivolve into [Eosmon] in your hand with the digivolution cost Reduced by 3.
